title: Back-to-School Digital Campaign: 'Ready for Term 3'
objective: Drive enrollment and trial sign-ups for an EdTech platform (e.g., online tutoring, learning app) during the peak back-to-school period in July, capturing parents actively searching for academic support.
target_audience: Parents of primary & secondary students (age 25–50, household income SGD 80k+), students aged 7–18, education decision-makers in households across Singapore.
key_activities: Performance-marketing campaign across Meta (Facebook/Instagram) and Google Search targeting 'tuition Singapore', 'online tutoring', 'exam prep July' keywords.
Content ecosystem: 8–10 organic social posts (carousel, Reels, stories) showcasing student success stories, term prep tips, parent testimonials.
Paid video ads (3 variants: rational 'structured curriculum', emotional 'student confidence', disruptive 'results in 4 weeks') running for 4 weeks.
Email nurture sequence (3–4 emails) for webinar sign-ups & free trial conversions.
Weekly performance dashboards tracking CAC, ROAS, conversion rate, and budget reallocation.
kpis: 1,200 trial sign-ups (target CAC: SGD 15–18 per signup)
18% CTR on paid video ads
3.5:1 ROAS on ad spend (SGD 15k spend → SGD 52.5k attributed revenue)
850 organic social impressions per post (avg)
6% email open rate, 2.5% click-through rate
zynth_services: Paid Ads (Meta & Google performance marketing)
Content Creation (video ads, carousel assets, Reels)
Social Media Management (organic posting cadence)
Email Marketing (nurture sequence setup & execution)
Analytics & Reporting (weekly performance dashboard)
why_now: July marks the end of school holidays and panic-driven enrollment searches. Parents are actively researching tuition and learning platforms to prepare students for term 3 or September exams. Search volume for 'tuition near me' and 'online tutoring' peaks in this window. Influencer season aligns (student accounts sharing summer learning prep content).
deliverables: 3 paid video ad variants (15–30s), fully produced and optimized
8 organic social posts (carousel, Reels, static) with captions
Google Search & Meta Ads campaigns (setup, targeting, bidding strategy)
3–4 email templates with copy & design
4 weekly performance reports with optimization recommendations
1 brand messaging document ('Ready for Term 3' positioning)

Event marketing: 6-week digital campaign (LinkedIn, Facebook, email) targeting 5,000+ education professionals; target 400 registrations (75% attendance).
On-site execution: registration desk, AV production (live captions, slide management), photography/video recap, post-event networking app.

key_activities: Venue partnerships: secure 3 community centers or school halls (East/Central/West) for 4-week pop-up camps (2–3 sessions per week, 15–20 students per session).
Camp curriculum design & instructor onboarding: 5–6 trained instructors, 4-week curriculum (Scratch, Python intro, robotics basics), daily lesson plans.
In-venue activation: branded backdrop, check-in system, parent observation area, merchandise (t-shirts, stickers), photo booth.
Social & influencer amplification: partner with 4–6 parenting/education micro-influencers (10–50K followers) to post camp behind-the-scenes content & testimonials.
Digital marketing: TikTok, Instagram Reels showing student demos & parent testimonials; paid ads targeting parents searching 'coding camp Singapore' and 'school holidays activities'.
Post-camp conversion: email nurture sequence & webinar (sample lesson) driving sign-ups for paid annual membership (SGD 299/year per student).

Creative asset production: New website (responsive design, CMS integration), 20+ brand guidelines (style guide, logo usage, imagery direction), product photography (app screenshots, UI mockups).

Website & onboarding redesign: new sign-up flow (3-step simplified process), in-app onboarding tutorial (3 min), SEO optimization (targeting 'personalized learning app Singapore', 'AI tutor').
Launch event (optional): 1 virtual webinar (90 min, hosted by founder + education expert) showcasing the rebrand, live Q&A, early-bird sign-up offer; target 200 registrations.
